scope: Cached native source states to eager learned tail; final whole-runtime scores are separate. Ordinary preservation compares the learned tail with a frozen native tail on each source cache, not full-model generation.
uncertainty: Pointwise cluster/prompt bootstrap; no seed/hardware uncertainty. Ordinary-chat aggregates have no recoverable confidence intervals.
